the orange color here needs adjustment because it is an essential graphic (no text equivalent provided), thus needs to have 3:1 color contrast against its (light yellow) background (currently 2.2:1).

Same would probably apply to the rain icon (blue) which is currently 2.2:1 against the light yellow. And the cloud (light gray) which is currently 1:1 against the light yellow. All have to be 3:1 or higher.

@Tatiana Mirson could we change the colors for the icons to have at least 3:1 in color contrast against their (light gray) background? These icons are essential because there is no other on-screen equivalent of this information provided, thus they're failing under the Non-Text Contrast WCAG criterion
